notes: me-ayin is fused as *whence* (rule 30) and carries the clause's supplied copula as its prepositional predicate (rules 20, 49), discontinuous around the explicit pronoun, which takes only *they*.
The head on the interrogative rather than the governing preposition is the reading taken; rule 23's syntactic-head clause would head on min, and the unit note records that.
shenei ha-anashim writes one *the*, which the present article on the rectum takes even though English fronts it (rule 29).
